title: Pure Gizmek
summary: Gizmek cards only, with generic Links and staples. Every Gizmek is a Machine whose ATK equals its DEF, and the deck chains them by Level. The 2021 cards lead. Gizmek Naganaki tributes a Gizmek to summon a lower-Level one from the Deck, and later returns a face-down banished one to the hand. Gizmek Taniguku stacks one on top of the Deck and revives one from the GY. Gizmek Inaba and Gizmek Arakami add bodies, and Sacred Scrolls of the Gizmek Legend digs three cards deep for one. The older Gizmeks punish the opponent's plays. Gizmek Makami searches when summoned, Gizmek Uka summons a Gizmek of the same Attribute as their monster, Gizmek Okami wipes the Extra Deck monsters on the field, and Gizmek Orochi banishes eight cards face-down to summon itself on either turn and destroys a monster.
